detail.readme_excerpt:
Awesome macOS Open Source Applications

A curated list of open source applications for macOS

Audio • Backup • Browser • Chat • Crypto • Database • Dev • Editors • Graphics • Productivity • Utilities

List of awesome open source applications for macOS. This list contains a lot of native, and cross-platform apps. The main goal of this repository is to find free open source apps and start contributing. Feel free to [contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md) to the list, any suggestions are welcome! To receive all new or popular applications you can join our [telegram channel](https://t.me/opensourcemacosapps). ## Support Hey friend! Help me out for a couple of :beers:! ## 📊 Statistics | Metric | Count | |--------|-------| | 📱 Total Applications | 988 | | 📂 Categories | 49 | | 🔝 Top Languages | Swift: 518 • Objective-C: 142 • Javascript: 125 • Typescript: 96 • Rust: 64 | ## Languages You can see in which language an app is written. Currently there are following languages: | Language | Icon | |----------|------| | C | | | C++ | | | C# | | | Clojure | | | CoffeeScript | | | CSS | | | Elm |
